audit.why: Tank-vs-tank standoff; neither kills the other in lane. The chart's Ornn-favoured middle stages match his Q-W-E burst cycle arriving before Sejuani's first tank item.
Spikes are correctly placed at Sejuani level 3 (full chain), Ornn 4-6 (combo cycle + Call of the Forge God), Sejuani first item and 2+ items. Ornn's Living Forge upgrades are named.

audit.whatIsWrong: 1) Volcanic Rupture is called a 'root' in whys[1] and wants.foe[0]; Riot's description gives damage and a slow, not a root. 2) The decisive interaction is never stated: Volcanic Rupture's magma pillar is terrain, and Searing Charge only knocks up when Ornn collides with terrain — so his own Q pillar is the setup for his E knockup. 3) wants.foe[1] says Brittle triggers 'whenever you're Frosted' — Frost is Sejuani's own stack on enemies and has nothing to do with Brittle, which comes from the final gout of Bellows Breath. 4) Fury of the North's Frost Armor grants immunity to slows, which answers Volcanic Rupture's slow — never mentioned.
audit.why: One CC type misnamed, one fabricated cross-kit link, and the matchup's actual kill pattern (pillar into charge) absent.
audit.corrected: Call Volcanic Rupture a slow; state that Searing Charge needs terrain and Ornn makes his own with the Q pillar; tie Brittle to Bellows Breath's final gout; state Frost Armor's slow immunity.

audit.why: The step-up window is defined by Volcanic Rupture 9s and Searing Charge 14s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sejuani's resistances are twice credited to 'passive Permafrost' / 'Permafrost passive'.
audit.why: Permafrost is the E stun; Frost Armor comes from Fury of the North and only exists after time out of combat.
audit.corrected: Renamed, and the out-of-combat condition stated.

edits.after: Your Q is live but Volcanic Rupture slows you and leaves a pillar every 9 seconds — trade W poke only, and never stand with that pillar at your back.

edits.before: Land Volcanic Rupture to root you and set up Bellows Breath's cone before you can Q out
edits.after: Slow you with Volcanic Rupture, then Searing Charge into his own pillar to knock you up

edits.before: Use Brittle passive from Bellows Breath to trigger massive burst damage whenever you're Frosted

edits.before: Ornn's Volcanic Rupture becomes a lane-control tool here; respect the pillar, avoid the Bellows Breath cone, and don't trade into his full-combo burst window.
edits.after: Volcanic Rupture's pillar is not just a zone to dodge — it is the terrain Searing Charge needs to knock you up, so never let a pillar sit between you and Ornn.

edits.before: Sunfire Aegis or Heartsteel tips the tank-on-tank war in your favor — your passive Permafrost resistances stack on top of first-item stats, and Ornn's forge-items don't fully kick in yet.
edits.after: Sunfire Aegis or Heartsteel tips the tank-on-tank war in your favor — Fury of the North's Frost Armor stacks on top of first-item stats, and Ornn's Living Forge upgrades don't fully kick in yet.

edits.before: Levels 1 and 2 are a genuine tank standoff — take W, control the wave with Winter's Wrath's slow, and never give Ornn a free auto under your turret where Bellows Breath hits hardest. At Level 3 your full Q into double-W strike into Permafrost stun is live: wait for him to step up to last-hit a cannon, Arctic Assault into the creep-wave, hit both W swings to max Frost stacks, then shatter with E. His Volcanic Rupture is telegraphed by a ground rune — dodge the pillar and never let it pin you for the Bellows follow-up.
edits.after: Levels 1 and 2 are a genuine tank standoff — take W, control the wave with Winter's Wrath's slow, and Frost Armor makes you immune to Volcanic Rupture's slow until he breaks it. At Level 3 your full Q into double-W strike into Permafrost stun is live: wait for him to step up to last-hit a cannon, Arctic Assault into the creep-wave, hit both W swings to max Frost stacks, then shatter with E. Volcanic Rupture leaves a magma pillar every 9 seconds — that pillar is terrain, and Searing Charge only knocks up on a terrain collision.

edits.before: Once you have Sunfire Aegis or Heartsteel built, the math flips: your Permafrost passive resistances stack on top of your tank items and you simply out-bulk his forge-item spikes in a sustained fight. The winning pattern is to keep Ornn on the wrong side of your Glacial Prison range — throw R from outside his Searing Charge distance, walk in while he's stunned in the blizzard, and complete the chain with Permafrost. He has no dash, no escape tool, and no answer to the CC duration you stack at this stage. Two items in you are the teamfight anchor he cannot be, and every objective fight where your R lands on him and one other champion is a won fight regardless of how the lane went.
edits.after: Once you have Sunfire Aegis or Heartsteel built, the math flips: Fury of the North's Frost Armor stacks on top of your tank items and you simply out-bulk his Living Forge spikes in a sustained fight. The winning pattern is to keep Ornn on the wrong side of your Glacial Prison range — throw R from 1300 units, far outside Searing Charge's 450, walk in while he's stunned in the blizzard, and complete the chain with Permafrost. He has no dash without terrain to charge into, and no answer to the CC duration you stack at this stage. Two items in you are the teamfight anchor he cannot be, and every objective fight where your R lands on him and one other champion is a won fight regardless of how the lane went.

edits.before: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture: matchup-defining — Pillar + knockup setup — stay off walls and sidestep the line. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget Q dash for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture: 9s at rank 1 — the pillar it leaves is the terrain Searing Charge (14s) needs for its knockup, so read them as one cooldown. Step up on their downtime. - Budget Q for emergencies and the R for opportunities.

notes: Two fabricated mechanics removed: Volcanic Rupture described as a root (it slows), and Brittle described as triggering 'whenever you're Frosted' (Brittle comes from Bellows Breath's final gout; Frost is Sejuani's own stack and is unrelated). Sejuani's resistances were twice attributed to 'Permafrost passive' — they are Fury of the North's Frost Armor. Bellows Breath's kit range reads 25000, which is a tooltip artefact, not a real cast range — not used anywhere. NOT ASSERTED: what Brittle actually amplifies (Riot's description says only that enemies become Brittle), so the text now says Ornn wants you Brittle before his knockup without claiming a number or a stun conversion. Data discrepancy for the user: the packet lists Ornn at 53.04% over 115 games while MC_WR_TABLES in champ-data/content/sejuani.js carries 48.94% over 805 games — I changed neither.
